source_data.prob_desc_description: Allen has a LOT of money. He has $$$n$$$ dollars in the bank. For security reasons, he wants to withdraw it in cash (we will not disclose the reasons here). The denominations for dollar bills are $$$1$$$, $$$5$$$, $$$10$$$, $$$20$$$, $$$100$$$. What is the minimum number of bills Allen could receive after withdrawing his entire balance?
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Output the minimum number of bills that Allen could receive.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first and only line of input contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^9$$$).
source_data.source_code:
<?php
$s = intval(readline());

$n = 0;
while(true)
{
	if($s >= 100)
	{
		$s -= 100;
		$n++;
	}
	else if($s >= 20)
	{
		$s -= 20;
		$n++;
	}
	else if($s >= 10)
	{
		$s -= 10;
		$n++;
	}
	else if($s >= 5)
	{
		$s -= 5;
		$n++;
	}
	else if($s >= 1)
	{
		$s -= 1;
		$n++;
	}
	else
	{
		echo $n;
		break;
	}
}
?>
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample case, Allen can withdraw this with a $$$100$$$ dollar bill, a $$$20$$$ dollar bill, and a $$$5$$$ dollar bill. There is no way for Allen to receive $$$125$$$ dollars in one or two bills.In the second sample case, Allen can withdraw two $$$20$$$ dollar bills and three $$$1$$$ dollar bills.In the third sample case, Allen can withdraw $$$100000000$$$ (ten million!) $$$100$$$ dollar bills.
